interface.title: ClimCanvas (ver 1.04.2)
interface.field: Atmospheric and ocean science / climate data visualization
interface.stage_of_work: Exploring gridded model or reanalysis output and making publication figures
interface.what_it_is_for: Load netCDF files and build layered maps, cross-sections, Hovmöller diagrams, line plots and scatter/bubble plots from a sidebar, then export each figure as an image, a standalone xarray/matplotlib script, or a JSON session.

data.note: Loaded the sample file data/sample/sample_atmos.nc (already in the path field) with Add. It holds t, z, u, v (time×level×lat×lon, 8×6×73×144) and precip, sst (time×lat×lon), with 6 pressure levels from 1000 to 200 hPa and 8 six-hourly times on 2024-01-01 and 01-02. The UI was switched from Japanese to English first.

features.name: Dataset loader with automatic axis-role detection
features.general: Load a data file by path, then see its variables, coordinates and which coordinate was taken as latitude, longitude, vertical and time
features.specific: Type the netCDF path and press Add; ds0 appears under Loaded files (with delete and an optional coordinate file); File info shows the data-variable table, the coordinate table and the auto-detected coordinates JSON
steps: expand File info to read the variable and coordinate tables and the detected roles
serves_tasks: Load a dataset file by path
Inspect variables, coordinates and detected axis roles

features.name: Layer stack editor
features.general: Stack several drawing layers on one plot, each with its own variable and style, and add or delete layers
features.specific: Under Layers, pick 'Layer kind to add' (Fill, Contours, Vector, Streamlines, Hatch in section/map modes) and press Add layer; each Layer N expander has Kind, Variable, contourf/pcolormesh, colormap, levels, opacity, colorbar, value transform, maskout and Delete this layer
steps: open the new layer and pick its variable
adjust its style (colormap, levels, line colour)
serves_tasks: Overlay a second field as lines
Make a vertical cross-section of a 4-D field
Make a map of a field at one level and time

features.name: Cross-section path picker
features.general: Cut a vertical slice through a 3-D field along a fixed line or along a path between two chosen points
features.specific: Under Cross-section, Orientation can be Longitude-height (fix latitude), Latitude-height (fix longitude) or along the great circle between two points; enter start/end lon/lat, choose the automatic number of points (it reports path length and spacing), set the pressure-level range, and label ticks with lon/lat
steps: keep or change the automatic number of sample points
serves_tasks: Cut the section along one coordinate
Cut the section along a path between two points

features.name: Time-section (Hovmöller) builder
features.general: Show how a field changes over time against height, latitude or longitude
features.specific: In Time section mode, set Kind to Time-height, Time-latitude or Time-longitude (Hovmöller convention) and narrow the Time range slider
serves_tasks: Show how a field changes over time

features.name: 1-D reduction plot
features.general: Reduce a multi-dimensional variable to a curve along one dimension, fixing or averaging the other dimensions
features.specific: In 1-D plot mode, choose Axes (time, level, lat or lon) and its Range; for each other dimension pick Fixed value or Range mean (optionally cos(lat)-weighted); layer Kind can be Line, Line bundle, line fill, Stack plot or Bar chart
steps: fix or range-average each other dimension
serves_tasks: Plot a variable as a 1-D curve along one dimension

features.name: Variable-vs-variable scatter / bubble
features.general: Plot one variable against another, optionally sizing points by a third, sampled along a chosen dimension
features.specific: In 2-D plot mode, choose the x-, y- and optional z-axis (bubble) variables, the 'Dim to draw along' and its range, fix the remaining dimensions for each variable, and switch Kind between Scatter and Bubble chart
steps: pick the x and y variables
optionally pick a z variable for bubble size
choose the dimension to draw along

features.name: Figure image export
features.general: Save the current figure as an image file in a chosen format and resolution
features.specific: Image export: Output format (PNG/JPG/TIFF/SVG/PDF/EPS), dpi, Output file name, background (white, set colour or transparent) and Trim margins, then Download
serves_tasks: Export the figure as an image file

features.name: Reproduction script generator
features.general: Turn the current figure into a standalone script that reloads the data and redraws it, with a live preview of the code
features.specific: 'Show generated script' previews the xarray/numpy/matplotlib code; under Reproduction script choose absolute or relative netCDF paths, include savefig and plt.show(), then Download script (figure.py)
steps: choose absolute or relative data paths
choose whether to include savefig and plt.show()
serves_tasks: Export a standalone script that redraws the figure
Preview the code that reproduces the figure

features.name: Session save and restore
features.general: Store the whole working state under a name or as a file, and reload it later
features.specific: Save → Session: 'To this PC' saves a named JSON into ~/.climcanvas/sessions (with a New subdirectory option), and 'Download' gives climcanvas_session.json. Restore session: 'From this PC' picks a saved file and Restore; an Upload tab is also offered
steps: save it to server storage or download it
serves_tasks: Save the whole working state for later
